name: NanoBanana.tech
tagline: An independent studio connecting prompts, examples and editing.
description: For reference-led image work, the independent Nano Banana workspace includes image-to-image creation. Text-to-image, an image editor, prompt recipes and photo editing guides are also part of the homepage offering. Prompt recipes, original downloadable examples and photo editing guides accompany the creation workspace. The site describes itself as independent; its image tools and educational material should be presented with that independent identity rather than as an official brand service. The homepage lists Nano Banana 2, Nano Banana Pro and Nano Banana 2.1 in its model offering. Text-to-image and image-to-image are both included, along with an image editor for working on images in the workspace. NanoBanana.tech is an independent third-party site and is not affiliated with Google.
